entries.title: Show HN: Beeper Mini – iMessage Client for Android
entries.author: erohead
entries.current_title: Show HN: Beeper Mini – iMessage client for Android
entries.excerpt: I’m proud to share that we (Beeper) have built a real 3rd party iMessage client for Android. We did it by reverse engineering the iMessage protocol and encryption system. Our new app, Beeper Mini, is available to download today (no waitlist): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.beeper.ima Unlike every other attempt to build an iMessage app for Android (including our first gen app), Beeper Mini does not use a Mac server relay in the cloud. The app connects direct
entries.guide_zh: Beeper Mini 通过逆向协议让 Android 直接连接 iMessage，无需 Mac 中继。

entries.author: jonatanheyman
entries.current_title: Show HN: Heynote – A dedicated scratchpad for developers
entries.excerpt: Hey! I made Heynote entirely for my own use case. For many years, I always had an Emacs instance running with the scratch buffer open, even long after I had abandoned Emacs as my programming editor in favor of more recent IDE:s. The simplicity of having just one big scratch buffer appeals to me, but I still want to separate the different things I jot down somehow (without using tabs or similar). entries.guide_zh: Heynote 为开发者提供可以分块记录内容的专用草稿本。
